newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yizheng, Dongfang down on poor results.
newsitem.headline: Yizheng, Dongfang down on poor results.

text.p: Shares of Yizheng Chemical Fibre Co Ltd and Dongfang Electrical Machinery Co Ltd, were sharply lower after the companies reported falls in interim earnings, brokers said.
Yizheng shares fell HK$0.09, or 5.00 percent, to HK$1.71 and Dongfang was down HK$0.075, or 3.09 percent, at HK$2.35.
"Investors are trimming their holdings in Yizheng after a bigger than expected fall in earnings," said Ben Kwong, research director from Dharmala Securities.
Kwong said the market expected a drop of about 30 to 40 percent while Yizheng posted a 74.6 percent fall in profit.
Dongfang Electrical, a power generator producer, said its interim profit fell to 28.36 million yuan from 34.36 million yuan.
